title: Telehealth Visits in the Insured Plan of Care Visit-Limit Count
content:
**Billing desk reference — Insured Plan of Care.** Telehealth treatment visits are not appointments of the in-clinic Appointment Series and are added to the visits counted against the visit limit:

1. Where telehealth treatment visits have been billed on the plan, those billed visits are added.
2. Where none has been billed and no retroactive request stands on the plan, the sessions attended on a telehealth series the plan funds (a Telehealth 30-Minute Visit Series) are added, as unbilled in-clinic appointments are when no retroactive request has been made.
3. Otherwise nothing is added for telehealth, unbilled sessions then counting only through the retroactive requests.

## Input, judgement and output (hypothetical)

| Telehealth treatment visits billed on the plan | Retroactive request on the plan | Sessions attended on the plan's telehealth series | Added |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | — | 5 | 3 |
| 0 | None | 5 | 5 |
| 0 | One stands | 5 | 0 |
| 0 | None | 0 | 0 |

The sessions and their attendance are read from the Appointment Series record of the telehealth series and its history.
